scripts.lint: tsgo --noEmit && tsgo --noEmit --project client/tsconfig.json && tsgo --noEmit --project api/tsconfig.json && tsgo --noEmit --project core/tsconfig.json && tsgo --noEmit --project dal/tsconfig.json && eslint . --config eslint.config.js --max-warnings=0 --fix
scripts.dev: bun run clean && concurrently --prefix "[{name}]" --names "TAILWIND,SERVER" --prefix-colors "magenta,yellow" "bun run tailwind --watch" "sleep 1; bun --hot ./server.ts"
scripts.build: bun run clean && bun run tailwind && bun build --production --outdir=.dist --target=bun ./server.ts
scripts.build:dev: bun run clean && bun run tailwind && bun build --outdir=.dist --target=bun ./server.ts
scripts.compile: bun run clean && bun run tailwind && bun build --production --compile --outfile=.dist/netminder --target=bun ./server.ts
scripts.compile:applesilicon: bun run clean && bun run tailwind && bun build --production --compile --outfile=.dist/netminder-macos-arm64 --target=bun-darwin-arm64 ./server.ts
scripts.compile:linux: bun run clean && bun tailwind && bun build --production --compile --outfile=.dist/netminder-linux-x64 --target=bun-linux-x64-baseline ./server.ts
